iteration_note: Counts are observed implementation/retest batches, not independent agent trials or human design rounds.
limitations: Single Chromium version for project matrix; light theme only.
First timing repetition includes screenshots and focus smoke; second omits them. Compare conditions within each repetition only; no performance-uplift claim.
Browser QA adapter is identical across labelled arms because product UI source is identical. Actual Factory source differences are exercised separately in routing-report.json and gate regressions.
Media automation covers visible img elements; CSS background media was visually inspected, not exhaustively checked.
Six issue groups are supported by automated findings/source/diagnostics. Focus smoke flags need per-control manual verification.
Foundation disambiguation is scoped to technical noun phrases; the interpreter remains heuristic, not general semantic understanding.
No product UI repair was performed. Zero UI repair rounds does not measure end-to-end redesign efficiency.
